title: Blog posts
description: Company blog posts for the public site
failDescription: An error occurred while loading blog posts. Please try again.

help.title: About blog posts
help.overview: A blog post is company content. Published posts appear on the public site. Drafts stay in the panel.

sections.title: What a post holds
items: Category (required), title, slug, body, optional excerpt.
Publish or hide from the row menu. Published date is set automatically on first publish.

sections.title: On this page
items: Create a draft, attach media, then publish from the list when the copy is ready.
Unpublished posts stay in the panel only.
